title: Jacobi-Zariski sequence for a quotient of a smooth algebra
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that $H_1(L_{B/A})=0$ and $\Omega_{B/A}$ is a projective $B$-module (e.g. $A\to B$ smooth) [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], let $\mathfrak a\subseteq B$ be an ideal and $C=B/\mathfrak a$, an $A$-algebra via $A\to B\to C$. Then there is an exact sequence of $C$-modules $$0\to H_1(L_{C/A})\to\mathfrak a/\mathfrak a^2\xrightarrow{\ \delta\ }C\otimes_B\Omega_{B/A}\xrightarrow{\ w\ }\Omega_{C/A}\to0,$$ where $\delta(a\bmod\mathfrak a^2)=1\otimes\mathrm da$ and $w(c\otimes\mathrm db)=c\,\mathrm d\bar b$ ($\bar b$ the class of $b$ in $C$; $\Omega$ and $\mathrm d$ as in [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]).

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00S2 (lemma-exact-sequence-NL, Jacobi-Zariski sequence, line 35412) for A -> B -> C, including its final assertion (if Tor_1^B(Omega_{B/A},C) = Tor_2^B(Omega_{B/A},C) = 0 then H_1(NL_{B/A} (x)_B C) = H_1(L_{B/A}) (x)_B C), with Lemma Tag 07BP (lemma-NL-surjection, line 35506: H_1(L_{C/B}) = a/a^2, Omega_{C/B} = 0) and Lemma Tag 00RU (lemma-differential-seq, line 34103) for the maps delta and w; this is the sequence used in More on Algebra, proof of Lemma 07M7 ('note that H_1(L_{B/A}) = 0 and that Omega_{B/A} is finite projective, in particular flat so the Tor group vanishes')

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-jacobi-zariski-homology-sequence] to the composable maps $A\to B\to C$. It gives the exact sequence of $C$-modules from that node, including the left base-change term and the right relative-differentials term.

Use [lem-weil-pbc-jacobi-zariski-surjection-h1] and [lem-weil-pbc-jacobi-zariski-surjection-differentials] for the surjection $B\twoheadrightarrow C=B/\mathfrak a$. They identify the relative degree-one homology with $\mathfrak a/\mathfrak a^2$ and make the final relative differential module zero.

By [lem-weil-pbc-jacobi-zariski-left-term-vanishing], projectivity of $\Omega_{B/A}$ gives the Tor vanishings required for base change, and the hypothesis $H_1(L_{B/A})=0$ kills the left term in the sequence of [lem-weil-pbc-jacobi-zariski-homology-sequence].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00S2, final assertion and proof, lines 35444--35446 and 35467--35485; More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07M7

proof.text: Finally [lem-weil-pbc-jacobi-zariski-differential-maps] gives the conormal and base-change differential maps, with $a\bmod\mathfrak a^2\mapsto1\otimes\mathrm da$ and $c\otimes\mathrm db\mapsto c\,\mathrm d\bar b$. Truncating the exact sequence using the two vanishing endpoints yields the asserted short exact sequence.

lean.statement: theorem jacobiZariski_quotient_smooth (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Subsingleton (H1Cotangent A B)] [Module.Projective B (KaehlerDifferential A B)] (a : Ideal B) : let C := B ⧸ a ∃ (i : H1Cotangent A C →ₗ[C] a.Cotangent) (δ : a.Cotangent →ₗ[C] C ⊗[B] KaehlerDifferential A B) (w : C ⊗[B] KaehlerDifferential A B →ₗ[C] KaehlerDifferential A C), Function.Injective i ∧ Function.Exact i δ ∧ Function.Exact δ w ∧ Function.Surjective w ∧ (∀ x : a, δ (a.toCotangent x) = 1 ⊗ₜ[B] KaehlerDifferential.D A B x) ∧ (∀ (c : C) (b : B), w (c ⊗ₜ[B] KaehlerDifferential.D A B b) = c • KaehlerDifferential.D A C (Ideal.Quotient.mk a b))
